FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 3.
Pg. 8. Patience - True Glory
"The learning of a man is known by patience, and his glory is to pass over wrongs." Prov. XIX-11.
And the Lord said to Abram "Go forth out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and out of thy Father's house, and come into the land which I shall shew thee. And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee and magnify thy name, and thou shalt be blessed ... and in thee shall all the kindred of the earth be blessed." Gen. XII.
Pg. 9. RESIGNATION - VOCATION
I have learned in whatsoever state I am, to be content therewith." (Phil. IV 11)
(Ps. 120-1 Levavi oculos meos) "I have lifted up my eyes to the mountains, from whence help shall come to me."
"To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness," Ps. CXI 4. "Come ye to him and be enlightened: and your faces shall not be confounded." Ps XXXIII 6.
"For that which is at present momentary and light of our tribu- lation ( .. II Cor. IV 17) worketh for us above measure exceedingly an eternal weight of glory."
Pg. 10. Blank
